limitation_of_liability: Each party's total liability under the agreement is capped at the fees paid or payable by the customer in the 12 months before the event giving rise to the claim. The cap applies equally to both parties.
auto_renewal: The agreement may renew automatically for one-year terms only if the vendor sends the customer written notice of the upcoming renewal at least 60 days before the renewal date. The customer may cancel by written notice at any time before the renewal date.
payment_terms: Invoices are due 45 days after the customer receives them (net 45). Late payments may accrue interest of no more than 1% per month.
termination_for_convenience: The customer may terminate for convenience on 30 days' written notice and receives a pro-rata refund of any prepaid fees for the period after termination.
